title: Handover to the customer
intro: Handover is recorded from the cashier's order page. Handover is not gated on payment: whether to release a garment against an outstanding balance is a matter for staff judgment.

steps.title: Open the order in Handover mode
steps.body: Open the order from the cashier. Where a balance is outstanding the page opens in Payment mode. Select Handover (1).

steps.title: Record the collection
steps.body: Select each garment being handed over (1), then select Collect (2). Only garments the customer is physically taking should be selected.

steps.title: Order completion
steps.body: The selected garments are recorded as completed. When every garment on the order has reached a terminal state, the order itself is closed.
